tools.name: sidequest_pricing
tools.description: List the task types Sidequest accepts, their bounty floors (card + USDC), and the payment methods enabled right now. Free.

tools.name: sidequest_post_task
tools.description: Post a task to the public board with a bounty. Unfunded + free — it becomes executable once someone (or run_task) pays. Returns the task id.

tools.name: sidequest_get_task
tools.description: Fetch one task by id — status, worker, result, payment reference. Free.

tools.name: sidequest_list_tasks
tools.description: Browse the public task board (most recent first). Filter by status or type. Free.

tools.name: sidequest_stats
tools.description: Public ledger stats — tasks by status/type, gross bounty settled, workers. The reputation seed. Free.

tools.name: sidequest_run_task
tools.description: Post AND execute a task atomically (the worker runs now and you get the result). Paid via MPP — card (Stripe) or USDC (Tempo). Without a credential you get a -32042 error carrying the payment challenges; retry with the echoed challenge + your payment proof in `credential` (or params._meta['org.payme

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: sidequest_run_task · Private data: sidequest_run_task · Public sink: sidequest_post_task, sidequest_run_task · Destructive: sidequest_run_task.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: sidequest_run_task · Private data: sidequest_run_task · Public sink: sidequest_post_task, sidequest_run_task · Destructive: sidequest_run_task

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
